attempts.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 with 7 compressed rotations and copytruncate (keeps the file descriptor valid so the app can keep writing post-rotation). Validated with logrotate dry-run, forced live rotations (verified compression via delaycompress, 7-rotation cap with oldest pruning, and continued writes to app.log after rotation), then restored original log content. Completed mandatory restart evidence: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the logrotate config, timer, and log content all persisted post-reboot.
